name: TimeLimitOnUse
summary: The card component of Time Limit on Use (DUO_0000025). The requester accepted the owner's terms document, and a compute node is attested to shut down no later than the owner's deadline. Outputs a DataUseConditionCredential about the requester.

requiredDocumentID.description: DID of the terms document the requester must accept. An AgreementCredential qualifies if claims.agreementInfo.documentID equals it.

notAfter.description: Deadline. A ComputeEnvironmentCredential qualifies if hasComputeProfile.profile.shutsDownAt <= notAfter, compared as strings. It is never compared with the current time.
